# About this sample {.unnumbered .unlisted #sec-index}

Side Quest is a sample book, made to test Quirework, a tool for writing books with AI, and to show it at work.
Its author, Cy Dequest, does not exist, and neither does anyone in it.
An AI played Cy, writing every one of Cy's messages, and AI models did the writing.
No person wrote, edited or reviewed its prose.

So read it for the structure Quirework keeps, not for the writing.
Quirework is made for an author who judges every page.
This book had no such author.

More at [quirework.com](https://quirework.com).
